description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance accuracy across eleven datasets for various training methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the different training methods ordered from left to right as Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical axis represents the Average Performance on a linear scale, displaying a value range from 0 to 60, with numerical tick labels and corresponding dashed horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 10. The chart consists of five individual vertical bars, each depicted in a distinct color. The first bar, representing the Standard method, is orange with an approximate value of 53. The Self-RAG bar is light brown with a value of approximately 54. The FactTune bar is yellow-green and represents the shortest bar in the chart with a value near 52. The CInGS (w/) bar is steel blue, reaching about 54. The final bar, labeled CInGS, is solid blue and represents the tallest bar at approximately 59. The chart displays individual, unstacked bars without any grouping, and the categories are not sorted in alphabetical or strictly ascending or descending order.
